# Plazmic Legends support

Start with the [README](../README.md) and
[package operations guide](../docs/package-operations.md). They cover supported
hosts, installation, launch commands, logs, rollback, and common AppImage
problems.

If the documented steps do not resolve the problem, open a bug report through
the repository issue chooser. Include:

- Plazmic Legends version;
- installation method;
- Linux distribution and version;
- X11 or XWayland session;
- Wine or Proton runner; and
- concise reproduction steps and the visible error category.

Do not attach `eqgame.exe`, game maps, Wine prefixes, memory captures,
credentials, character or spawn names, or logs containing personal paths.
Redact sensitive information before sharing diagnostics.

Security vulnerabilities do not belong in public issues. Follow
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead.
